improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support. Try three free searches, then join from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | Your AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta property="og:description" content="Meet Gideon: a Claude-powered assistant built for business owners, traders, and professionals. Instant AI answers, voice chat, and unlimited workspace access. Start with 3 free searches.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:image" content="https://gdn.ai/og-image.png">
<meta property="og:url" content="https://gdn.ai/">
improvements.rationale: A clear meta description improves click-through rates from search results by communicating the core value prop and free trial offer. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when the link is shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. The copy stays factual, highlights the Claude-powered differentiator, and includes the low entry price to reduce friction.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Partner"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace built for professionals. Try three searches free — no card required."
improvements.rationale: The headline immediately introduces Gideon by name and positions it as a partner rather than just a tool, building trust. The subheading highlights three core value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) while emphasizing the risk-free trial with 'no card required' to reduce friction and boost conversions.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to become a member to continue accessing Gideon. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, billed monthly—or save 30% with an annual plan. As a member, you'll unlock unlimited access to your personal workspace, voice chat, and Gideon's full suite of trade and business support tools.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in a freemium model—what happens at the paywall. It reassures prospects by clearly explaining the transition, reinforces value with specific pricing from the site context, and highlights the annual savings incentive to encourage higher-commitment conversions.
